text.p: Stocks of peanuts held in U.S. commercial storage on September 30 totaled 871 million lbs of equivalent farmer stock, down 48 percent from 1.68 billion lbs a year ago, the U.S. Agriculture Department said.
End-September stocks included 532 million lbs of farmer stock versus 933 million lbs a year ago.
Shelled peanuts totaled 329 million lbs of equivalent farmer stock versus 714 million lbs a year ago. September roasting stocks totaled 9.6 million lbs versus 35 million a year ago.
Commodity Credit Corporation uncommitted stocks in September stood at 15 million versus 114 a year earlier.
End-September stocks of shelled peanuts included 173 million lbs of edible grades and 75 million lbs of oil stock, USDA said.
September millings totaled 129 million lbs, including 13 million lbs of Virginia peanuts and 112 million lbs of runners.
Shelled peanuts crushed for oil, cake and meal totaled 62 million lbs, the department said.
